design §1.12: the bound is 4,096 comparisons; raised, limbo's pathological::nc-dos-3 shape (the subject against 4,097 subtrees) is within it.
The bound is exactly 4,096: 63 entries and the subject against 64 subtrees (4,096) are within it.
At exactly 4,096 comparisons the path is within the bound, not beyond it.
The subject is checked against every subtree too (limbo pathological::nc-dos-3 has no SAN entry, only 4,097 subtrees and a large subject).
The bound is per path, not per certificate: two certificates of 2,080 comparisons each are beyond it together.
Without the check no path is beyond the bound: limbo's pathological::nc-dos-1 shape (2,048 entries against 4,097 subtrees) would be within it.
Every set of the state costs comparisons: two sets of 40 subtrees are 80 per entry.
Excluded subtrees cost comparisons like permitted ones (limbo nc-dos-3: 2,048 permitted and 2,049 excluded).
The executable result is the spec's and also within the bound: without it, a path of 64 entries against 64 subtrees (4,160 comparisons), which the spec accepts, is promised accepted.
The bound only adds a refusal: a path the spec refuses must not be promised accepted just because it is within the bound.
Acceptance needs the spec's acceptance and the bound, not either.
